internal_route_manifest.context_window_tokens: JSON safe integer 1..9007199254740991 or null; bool forbidden
internal_route_manifest.privacy: content-free; no raw content, arbitrary name, id, path, URL, hash, secret, hidden reasoning, file/tool/artifact bytes, or source snippet
internal_route_manifest.provider_behavior: deeply frozen internal-only metadata; excluded from provider bytes and ProviderWireEnvelope/authority/catalog/request digests; cannot alter provider behavior

contributions.canonical_order: category order, then category-specific subtype order, then surface order
contributions.token_formula: for each canonical tuple estimated_tokens=max(1,ceil(utf8_bytes/4)); tuple/category/subtype/attributed totals are checked sums only and never tokenizer-exact or proportionally rescaled

routes.manifest_items: JSON safe integer 0..9007199254740991; bool forbidden; total known logical source instances including known uninstrumented instances; >= sum(contributions[*].source_count)
routes.provider_retained: JSON bool; indicates a retained-context request only, never exact classification of invisible retained tokens
routes.wire_surfaces: JSON safe integer 0..4; bool forbidden; distinct non-empty authoritative surfaces including known uninstrumented surfaces; >= distinct contribution.surface count

pupu_fresh_hint.admission: sidecar recomputes TextEncoder(UTF-8).encode(text.slice(0, composer.templateLength)).length from authoritative fresh message/composer evidence; only an exact positive-safe-integer match is admitted
pupu_fresh_hint.fresh_only: optional by absence; invalid or mismatched fresh hints are discarded for composition only and never enter durable state
pupu_fresh_hint.privacy: no names, raw content, ids, paths, URLs, hashes, arbitrary labels, or extra keys

pupu_private_durable_hint.authority: only the stable durable option or its same-transaction freshly admitted value; arbitrary component_state is forbidden
pupu_private_durable_hint.fresh_write: canonical admitted public value is atomically minted byte-identically into the stable durable resume option allowlist
pupu_private_durable_hint.projection: semantic/local_replay maps the tuple to messages; remote_continuation with provider_retained=true maps it to provider_state; identical tuples merge with checked safe-integer arithmetic before canonical sort
pupu_private_durable_hint.rehydration: graph-step and resume restore the canonical bytes unchanged
pupu_private_durable_hint.resume: absent public declaration uses durable private value; exact canonical equality is declaration-only with no write/version advance; malformed, unequal, or present-with-no-baseline cannot mint or overwrite, omits this physical call's composition extension, emits content-free diagnostic, and leaves ordinary V4 resume available

physical_call_identity.after_send_before_cas: recovery reuses exact durable subject, fallback parent, route digest, and deterministic physical ordinal
physical_call_identity.callback_context: before-send, after-send, and receipt callbacks receive one immutable ProviderPhysicalSendContext
physical_call_identity.identity_route: existing generic provider endpoint semantics remain unchanged
physical_call_identity.kernel_attempt_telemetry: max(legacy attempt count, deterministic physical ordinal); telemetry never defines durable identity

physical_ordinal.openai_previous_response_fallback: currently allowed primary ordinal 0 maps to fallback physical ordinal 1
physical_ordinal.primary: route-local retry ordinal n maps to physical ordinal n
physical_ordinal.primary_retry_gt_0_to_fallback: unsupported and fail closed; separate P1 authorization required

physical_call_identity.route_selection: select exact route manifest only after authoritative wire finalization; unmatched route yields unavailable or partial composition and never guesses or changes the send
physical_call_identity.wire_evidence: wire.route_name is exact ProviderRequestSubject.route; wire.route_sha256 is exact ProviderWireRoute digest

receipt_extension.attributed_tokens: JSON safe integer 0..9007199254740991; bool forbidden; equals sum(categories[*].tokens)

categories.items: 0..10; unique; sorted by taxonomy category order; zero entries omitted
categories.source_count: JSON safe integer 1..9007199254740991; bool forbidden; equals sum(subtypes[*].source_count)

subtypes.items: 1..category allowlist length; unique; sorted by category-specific subtype order

categories.tokens: JSON safe integer 1..9007199254740991; bool forbidden; equals sum(subtypes[*].tokens)

receipt_extension.context_window_tokens: JSON safe integer 1..9007199254740991 or null; bool forbidden
quality_invariants: coverage.status=complete iff matched_items=manifest_items and matched_surfaces=wire_surfaces; otherwise coverage.status=partial

known instrumentation loss is encoded by route manifest_items>sum(contribution.source_count) or wire_surfaces>distinct contribution.surface count and forces quality=partial plus coverage.status=partial
reconciled_estimate requires coverage.status=complete, non-null residual_tokens, authoritative receipt input total, attributed_tokens<=input total, and residual_tokens=input total-attributed_tokens

attributed overestimate preserves category/subtype estimates and uses estimated when coverage complete or partial when coverage partial, with null residual; no clamp, proportional scaling, residual zero, equality, or percentage claim
provider input total remains only in receipt.usage.input.total_tokens and is never copied into this extension
after exact route selection matched_items=sum source_count for declared tuples whose surface is present in authoritative selected-route wire; matched_surfaces=distinct represented surfaces present
provider-retained invisible context and unmatched authoritative route are never claimed as exactly classified; exact route mismatch omits extension
receipt_extension.residual_tokens: JSON safe integer 0..9007199254740991 or null; bool forbidden

receipt_failure_boundary.base_receipt: composition enrichment may degrade only after a valid base receipt has been constructed
receipt_failure_boundary.composition_failure: omit or reject composition extension with stable unavailable reason while preserving provider call and valid base receipt

run_bundle_carriage.integrity: receipt extension covered by immutable receipt hash; receipt-set carriage covered by RunBundle digest

runtime_features.admission: composition_availability_only; MUST NOT enter global _REQUIRED_PROTOCOLS or block ordinary V4/provider send, tools, interactions, or base RunBundle creation
runtime_features.missing_behavior: Context Composition unavailable with stable reason; breakdown hidden or disabled; existing receipts and bundles remain valid
